Baseline runs hit avoidable validation errors the skill prevents: nonexistent 'ubuntu:' remote (deploy-web-with-profile), custom-volume attach without required path (dedicated-storage-pool), two project-scoped bridge attempts plus wrong default-pool name (isolated-project-network).

With-skill eval 3 probed features.networks feasibility first, documented that enabling it without OVN blinds the project's network view, and kept it off; the baseline enabled it, leaving a latent misconfiguration that passes these assertions.
Existence/state assertions (pool exists, instance RUNNING) pass everywhere and do not discriminate; error counts, recovery behavior, and wall time carry the observed skill value.
